data.narrative:
Orbital Composites is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Cole Nielsen and Amolak Badesha that has raised $6.6M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a broader Robotics & Manufacturing comp universe of 9 private companies and 1 public company (277810.KQ), including peers such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

A stage-progression method is applicable here, using the company's $6.6M total raised as a proxy baseline of $2M and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement in this sector. This produces an implied valuation of $6M. A peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-set comparables; while 10 same-sector peers exist, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier companies yielded fewer than three datapoints, making sector-wide aggregation unreliable.

The triangulated analysis, constrained to one applicable method, supports a valuation range of $5M to $7M, with a median of $6M. Key uncertainties center on the absence of tight peer comparables and the reliance on a single methodological pillar. The valuation should be stress-tested against milestones in product-market fit, customer traction, and competitive positioning as additional data emerges.
